start_here: Say to your AI: "Open https://example.com in the browser inside my terminal." It reads the row, installs terminal-browser if it is missing, runs it and shows you the result.
no_lists_because: It keeps no list: terminal-browser is a program that runs on the person's own computer.
instructions: 1. Say to your AI: "Open https://example.com in the browser inside my terminal." It reads the row with do_one_thing_in_my_account at @tools, method tools:list, input {tool: "tool:github:zenbu-labs-terminal-browser"}.
2. It checks that Homebrew and a terminal with kitty graphics are on your computer, and if terminal-browser is missing it runs the get_it steps: brew install terminal-browser.
3. It runs the row's command: terminal-browser open https://example.com
4. Read what it shows you. The site you asked through runs none of this; it all happens on your own computer.
